// Acuity blur (linear light, Gaussian). Off by default in the app.
const val ACUITY_K = 1.3661644f
const val ACUITY_RATIO = 3.75f  // dog; see the per-animal ratios below
const val ACUITY_HFOV_DEG = 70f  // along the frame's long edge
const val DOG_ACUITY_RATIO = 3.75f
const val DOG_PERIPHERAL_BLUR = 0f
const val DOG_SHADOW_GAMMA = 1f
const val CAT_ACUITY_RATIO = 3.5f
const val CAT_PERIPHERAL_BLUR = 1f
const val CAT_SHADOW_GAMMA = 0.85f
const val ACUITY_DEFAULT_EXAGGERATION = 1f
const val ACUITY_MAX_EXAGGERATION = 8f

/** Gaussian sigma in pixels for a frame whose long edge is [longEdgePx] pixels. */
fun acuitySigmaPx(
    longEdgePx: Float,
    exaggeration: Float = ACUITY_DEFAULT_EXAGGERATION,
    acuityRatio: Float = ACUITY_RATIO,
): Float =
    ACUITY_K * (acuityRatio / 60f / 2f) * (longEdgePx / ACUITY_HFOV_DEG) * exaggeration

// Shadow lift (artistic, off by default): rgb *= min(Y^(gamma - 1), max(1, 1 / max(r, g, b))),
// Y = luma(rgb) clamped to [1e-6, 1], scale 1 when Y >= 1; the cap keeps channels at or below 1.
const val SHADOW_LIFT_OFF_GAMMA = 1f
const val SHADOW_LIFT_SUGGESTED_GAMMA = 0.85f
const val SHADOW_LIFT_STRONGEST_GAMMA = 0.7f
